item.title: Foot Locker and Champs add delivery options through DoorDash
item.description: Along with Kids Foot Locker and Champs Sports, Foot Locker will be available through DoorDash's platform and DashPass membership program.

item.title: Lululemon gets help from international and digital sales in Q4
item.description: A 9% rise in digital sales year over year offered assistance in Q4 as Lululemon continued to face larger challenges.

item.title: Amazon signals ecommerce delivery shift as USPS contract talks stall
item.description: Amazon has not said it will fully exit its USPS relationship, but its planning points to a more diversified approach to its next contract.

item.title: Coveo adds conversational product discovery to ecommerce search
item.description: Coveo said ecommerce retailers maintain control over search results through predefined layouts, merchandising rules and content guardrails.

item.title: New B2B marketplaces target construction, equipment and data center sourcing
item.description: As B2B marketplaces scale, they are likely to place greater emphasis on areas of procurement where many distributors are still investing.

item.title: Amazon gets back together with FedEx to expand free returns options
item.description: The returns offering comes after an end to Amazon's ground delivery contract with FedEx in 2019 chilled the companies' relationship.

item.title: Meta adds eBay to its growing affiliate commerce program
item.description: The Meta program, which already includes Amazon and Shopee, will allow eBay listings to be tagged directly in Facebook posts and Reels.

item.title: GigaCloud partners with Otto Group to expand European marketplace assortment
item.description: The partnership between GigaCloud and Otto reflects broader marketplace-driven expansion strategies in B2B ecommerce.

item.title: Würth expands e-procurement integration to streamline B2B purchasing
item.description: Würth said automation in e-procurement is saving an average of seven minutes per order, or about 490,000 minutes annually — 8,167 hours.

item.title: AI pushes B2B ecommerce toward fewer platforms as budgets shift
item.description: For B2B sellers, the report points to a more disciplined approach to AI in ecommerce investment, with a focus on data utilization.

item.title: Sysco-Restaurant Depot deal signals a shift to hybrid B2B ecommerce
item.description: Executives said the Sysco-Restaurant Depot acquisition deal will create “a nationwide omnichannel food service provider.”

item.title: ProVendorConnect launches B2B marketplace for property managers
item.description: The ProVendorConnect B2B marketplace platform allows property managers and HOA boards to post tenders, define scope and review bids.

item.title: Retailers sign on for Firmly agentic commerce platform
item.description: Firmly said its agentic commerce platform integrates with retailers' systems and runs automated testing to validate the integration.

item.title: Allbirds to be sold for $39 million
item.description: American Exchange Group would become Allbirds' new owner as the footwear and apparel brand ends a difficult period as a public company.
